title: Generic groundwater topology composition
goal: Replace qualification-specific topology wiring with one typed deterministic production topology model that maps admitted SWAP participants to admitted groundwater cells and MODFLOW API slots without changing predictor/corrector, transaction, publication or physics semantics.
reconcile_findings: groundwater_direct_tile_binding_t is cell-local and contains tile id, cell id and area fraction only
modflow6_api_slot_binding_t is package-local and independently maps cell id to package slot/node
mod_groundwater_multiswap_topology canonicalizes tiles only inside one cell
F-GC45-F-GC47 prove N:1, multi-cell and mixed topologies but encode topology in qualification bridges
no canonical global typed topology authority currently binds tiles, lineages, ledgers, cells and API slots together
invariants: each tile id and SWAP lineage id has exactly one topology owner
each ledger id has exactly one tile owner
each groundwater cell has exactly one package slot and MODFLOW node
each tile references an existing groundwater cell
each groundwater cell has at least one tile
area fractions close to one independently per groundwater cell
coupling and groundwater lineage/service metadata are identical for tiles sharing one groundwater cell
canonical order is groundwater_cell_id then tile_id; API order is package_slot
validation completes before any downstream composition mutation
no scientific assertion that N:1 aggregation is physically transferable
next_permitted_action: Open F-GC49 generic groundwater application orchestration from canonical. First implement the production Fortran application-plan materializer consuming this admitted topology; then qualify before adding the production participant bridge or generic live service.
implemented: production mod_groundwater_topology_composition with normalized tile and cell contracts
global uniqueness validation for tile ids, SWAP lineages, ledger ids, cell ids, coupling ids, groundwater lineages, package slots and MODFLOW nodes
per-cell fraction closure and orphan/missing-cell validation
canonical cell and cell/tile ordering independent of input permutation
materialization to admitted groundwater_direct_tile_binding_t for F-GC40
materialization to admitted modflow6_api_slot_binding_t for F-GC34
owner regressions for F-GC45 N:1, F-GC46 multi-cell and F-GC47 mixed topology
F-VQ120 independent executable downstream compatibility qualification
admission_criteria: exact-head F-GC48 owner O0/O2 qualification green
exact-head F-VQ120 downstream compatibility O0/O2 qualification green
canonical delta reconciled with no conflicting topology/runtime authority
scope remains topology/ownership only and does not claim heterogeneous transferability

one normalized typed cell authority for coupling/service/groundwater-lineage/MODFLOW slot/node ownership
global uniqueness and fail-closed missing/orphan ownership validation
deterministic canonical cell and cell/tile ordering
one topology contract reproducing F-GC45 N:1, F-GC46 multi-cell and F-GC47 mixed topology shapes
